translationRepairs: Humi had earlier sided with Tibet; on wuwu day its king Fazang sent envoys to surrender.
Humi had earlier sided with Tibet; on wuwu day its king Xiejilifu sent envoys to surrender.
頡吉裡匐 is the Humi king; "Fazang" is not a rendering of the name.

On dinghai day the Turkic western yabghu Abu Si, western shad Geladuo, Mo-ch'o's grandson Bodezhi, junior consort Yiran, and Bilge Qaghan Dengli's daughter led more than a thousand yurts to surrender in succession, and Turkish power waned.

伊然小妻 means the junior wife of Yiran Qaghan, not a consort named Yiran.

Su Xiaoyun, former magistrate of Ji reported the affair to An Lushan, who brought it to the emperor. The emperor summoned all sixty-four passers for a personal examination. Shi held his paper all day and could not write a single character. People called it "dragging a blank sheet."
前薊令蘇孝韞: Ji is the county, Su Xiaoyun the person.

親信大繼蜀貨 means a confidant delivered Shu goods in quantity; Da Ji is not a name.

林甫之舅子 means Wei Jian was the son of Li Linfu's maternal uncle.

嗣虢王巨 is Li Ju, the inheriting Prince of Guo.
